label: Bible Study
prompt: Blessed is the man that _____ in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
verse: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
note: The blessed man of Jeremiah, sketched as a riverside tree in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Grace and peace be _____ unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verse: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
note: Peter's greeting doesn't just wish grace and peace — it wants them multiplied.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the gates of it shall not be _____ at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
verse: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
note: Ancient city gates were closed at night; heaven's gates are never shut, because there is no night there.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen _____ unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verse: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
note: God to a nervous Ananias about Saul the persecutor: this man is my chosen vessel — now go.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth _____, and where thieves break through and steal:
verse: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
note: Earthly treasure has two enemies, says Jesus: moth for the cloth and rust for the metal — both 'doth corrupt.'
